text: Benin City (Nigeria) was founded or first settled around 1180 CE (approx.).
Venice (Italy) was founded or first settled around 421 CE (approx.).
Mexico City (Mexico) was founded or first settled around 1325 CE (approx.).
Byblos (Lebanon) was founded or first settled around 5000 BCE (approx.).
Ravenser Odd (UK (Humber estuary)) was founded or first settled around 1235 CE (approx.).
Anuradhapura ended or was abandoned around 993 CE.
Chan Chan ended or was abandoned around 1470 CE.
Buddhas of Bamiyan ended or was abandoned around 2001 CE.
Monte Albán ended or was abandoned around 850 CE.
Beijing: Ji, then the Mongols' Dadu, then the Ming and Qing capital. Capital of China for most of the last 750 years; around 1800 perhaps the largest city on earth.
Hangzhou: Lin'an, the Southern Song capital at the end of the Grand Canal. Marco Polo called it the finest city in the world; possibly the world's largest around 1200.
Medina: Yathrib, the oasis town where Muhammad moved in 622. The Hijra year 622 is year one of the Islamic calendar.
Aachen: Charlemagne's favourite residence and burial place. German kings were crowned here for about 600 years.
Córdoba: Capital of the Umayyad caliphate of al-Andalus. Around 1000 perhaps the largest city in Europe, with a famous library and the Great Mosque.
Berlin, 1871 CE: Capital of the German Empire.
Lisbon, 1497 CE: Da Gama sails for India.
Nanjing, 1421 CE: Ming court moves to Beijing.
Persepolis, 518 BCE: Darius I begins building.
Tyre, 1291 CE: Taken by the Mamluks.
Teotihuacan, 200 CE: Pyramid of the Sun completed.
Delhi, 1206 CE: Delhi Sultanate founded.
Naples had about 280,000 people in 1600 CE.
Damascus had about 90,000 people in 1200 CE.
Bruges had about 46,000 people in 1340 CE.
Mexico City had about 200,000 people in 1500 CE.
Fez had about 150,000 people in 1300 CE.
Egypt (New Kingdom) lasted from 1550 BCE to 1070 BCE.
Khmer Empire lasted from 802 CE to 1431 CE.
Hittite Empire peaked around 1300 BCE at about 0.6 million km².
Ptolemaic Egypt peaked around 240 BCE at about 1 million km².
